correctness.rationale: Conditioning on a noncrossed chord with k endpoints-pairs inside splits the remaining matching into two independent uniform submatchings; a connected motif cannot have vertices in both arcs. Counting (2n-2k-1) endpoint choices yields the exact covariance sum. Vandermonde C(k,r)+C(n-1-k,r)≤C(n-1,r)<C(n,r) proves strict sign. The adjacent-chord term gives -p_H n^{r-1}/(r-1)!; nonadjacent terms have O(n^{r-2}) total for fixed r by a factorial ratio tail bound. Independent exhaustive perfect-matching enumeration for n≤5 and connected K2 verified the finite identities. Enumeration does not replace the asymptotic tail proof.
residual_risks: Uniform endpoint matching, realizable connected induced motif, fixed motif size in asymptotics; historical equivalent generating functions possible.
